versions.changelog: v1.0.2 — Fix all documentation contradictions flagged by security scanner. SECURITY.md now accurately documents SQLite cache, optional API keys, and clarifies ANALYSIS.md is a roadmap doc (no Playwright/scraping in current release). All env vars are optional — core features remain 100% keyless via Open-Meteo + Wikivoyage + Nominatim. Added package-lock.json for full dependency auditability.

v1.0.1 — Implement all missing source files (weather, wikivoyage, itinerary, budget, cache, formatter). Resolves docs/code mismatch flagged by ClawHub scanner. TypeScript compiles clean. Skill is now fully functional.
Initial release — day-by-day itineraries, live weather, Wikivoyage guides, budget estimates. Free APIs, no API key required for core features.
